summary: Retro-test of 5 Paskamer Praat PWA additive extensions (pp-live-tab-v1, pp-live-start-v1, pp-live-player-v1, pp-live-v1.css, pp-reviews-relocate-v1). BACKEND: /api/ and /api/downloads/* work correctly. FRONTEND (BLOCKER): the preview URL https://paskamer-stability.preview.emergentagent.com does NOT serve the PWA at /app/pwa/ - it serves an empty Emergent CRA React starter template ('Building something incredible ~!'). None of the 5 extension <script> tags are present in the served HTML, none of them are reachable as JS/CSS assets (they all fall back to the SPA index.html with content-type text/html). Consequently, all UI-facing features (Paskamer Studio bottom-tab, Reviews-menu relocate, category chips, outfit-vergelijker overlap fix) cannot be verified in this environment.

Extension scripts pp-live-tab-v1.js, pp-live-start-v1.js, pp-live-player-v1.js, pp-live-v1.css, pp-reviews-relocate-v1.js are NEVER loaded by the browser in this environment.

critical_code_review_comments: Ingress/routing gap: the codebase contains BOTH a CRA React app in /app/frontend and a legacy vanilla-JS PWA in /app/pwa, but only /app/frontend is actually served at '/'. This makes any PWA changes untestable via the preview URL. Add clear README section explaining which deploy target hosts which app.

No FastAPI StaticFiles mount for the PWA in /app/backend/server.py - only /api/downloads/{filename} handles PWA asset serving. If the intent is to serve /app/pwa via FastAPI, add app.mount('/', StaticFiles(directory='/app/pwa', html=True), name='pwa') AFTER api_router (so /api/* still routes to endpoints).
Cache-busting is applied only in /app/pwa/index.html (?v=60.1.185-premium-studio) which is not served, so the versioning has no effect in this environment.
/api/health missing (Task suggested it as a fallback health probe).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 5 PWA extension files exist and are correctly wired into /app/pwa/index.html (lines 1046-1051 include all 5 with ?v=60.1.185-premium-studio cache buster). The PROBLEM is purely deployment/routing: the Emergent preview URL serves /app/frontend/ CRA template at '/'. Once main agent either (a) mounts /app/pwa/ via FastAPI StaticFiles, or (b) confirms testing should happen elsewhere (Cloudflare Pages), re-run backend/tests/test_paskamer_extensions.py - the 6 currently-failing tests will start passing. For UI, a Playwright script should then test: mobile 390x844 -> bottom nav contains 'Paskamer Studio', does NOT contain 'Reviews', hamburger menu on card-hub contains 'Reviews' item, click Paskamer Studio -> renders category chips + empty state. Backend downloads endpoints (/api/downloads/01-paskamerpraat-pwa-cloudflare.zip and /api/downloads/pp-combined-worker-v1.0.js) already work correctly with proper content-types.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: split deployment. Repository holds two frontends (/app/frontend CRA + /app/pwa vanilla-JS PWA). Supervisor + Kubernetes ingress route '/' to the CRA dev server on port 3000. Only the FastAPI backend at /api/* is shared. All /app/pwa assets, including index.html and /extensions/**, are unreachable via the Emergent preview URL because neither Nginx nor FastAPI StaticFiles is mounted for that directory. Reproduction: curl -I https://paskamer-stability.preview.emergentagent.com/extensions/live/pp-live-tab-v1.js -> returns HTTP 200 but content-type: text/html and body is the CRA index.html (SPA fallback). Mitigation options: (1) Add StaticFiles mount in backend/server.py for /app/pwa, (2) Serve /app/pwa via a separate static-file supervisor entry, (3) Verify the intended test target with the user - production paskamerpraat.nl may be where these extensions actually live.
